# TEST-01 — Matrix live limit and resume check

**Tracking issue:** https://github.com/tonygward/audio-plugins/issues/219
**Origin:** Generated by Matrix from the tracking issue when the card was picked up, because no prompt file existed and the issue had enough detail. The issue text below is the specification.

**Temporary live test of Matrix limits and resume. Safe to delete.** Created while finishing AUTO-12 (#180) and AUTO-14 (#208). It changes no plugin code.

## Objective
Prove on the real board that a task stopped by a limit is reported as Blocked with the limit named, and that moving its card back to Doing resumes it. The visible result is one small documentation file.

## Implementation
Create the file `analog-compressor/docs/matrix-live-test.md` containing a heading `# Matrix live test` and one plain sentence saying that this file was written by Matrix while testing limits and resume, and can be deleted. Change nothing else. Do not touch any plugin source, test, resource or the changelog.

## Acceptance criteria and tests
The file exists at that path, has the heading and exactly one sentence below it, and no other file is changed. Test by reading the file back and checking the pull request lists only this one file.
